summary: Coin has no designer guide for Text; use its facts from the package types.

examples.jsx: <Text text="Paid from your JioFinance account." modes={{ 'Color Mode': 'Light' }} />

props.name: text
props.description: The text content to display. You may also pass content as JSX children (e.g. `<Text>Hello</Text>`) — when both are provided, `children` wins.

props.name: children
props.description: Child nodes (string, number, or nested <Text>/<RNText> elements). This mirrors the standard React Native `<Text>` API so the component is a near-drop-in replacement.

props.name: textAlign
props.description: Horizontal alignment of the text. Default "Left", from the component source.

props.name: modes
props.description: Modes configuration for design token resolution.

props.name: numberOfLines
props.description: Number of lines to limit the text to.

props.name: disableTruncation
props.description: When `true`, disables text truncation entirely: the trailing ellipsis (`…`) is never shown and any `numberOfLines` clamp is ignored. The text is also never shrunk by a tight parent — it keeps its full intrinsic size and overflows (even breaking the parent layout) rather than clipping into an ellipsis. It still wraps onto multiple lines.

props.name: singleLine
props.description: When `true`, forces the text onto a single line with no wrapping (implies {@link disableTruncation}). On web the line overflows horizontally — brutally breaking the parent layout if it has to — instead of wrapping or truncating.

props.name: loading
props.description: Explicit per-instance loading override. When `true`, this `Text` renders a skeleton placeholder regardless of any surrounding `<SkeletonGroup>`. When `false`, the surrounding group is ignored for this instance. When omitted, the surrounding group's `loading` flag wins.

props.name: skeletonWidth
props.description: Optional width used while the skeleton is showing. Numbers are dp; `'100%'` (etc.) is a valid RN dimension. Defaults to a character-count heuristic based on the resolved font size and the supplied content.

props.name: skeletonLines
props.description: Optional explicit line count for the skeleton placeholder. Defaults to `numberOfLines ?? 1`. Useful when `numberOfLines` is intentionally unbounded but you want a sensible multi-line placeholder.

modes.name: Color Mode
modes.description: A token collection Text reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.
